milestone_risk.regulatory_basis: FCC license condition -- 50% of authorized constellation deployed (per FCC DA 26-553): required deployment of 1,616 satellites by this date

unlaunched_inventory.calculation_note: UPPER: elapsed_days x capacity_ceiling (production never throttled down from its stated target rate). launch_disruption_timeline.description: 32 satellites deployed; SpaceX publicly disputed the deployment altitude as creating unmitigable collision risk with dozens of operational spacecraft near the 480km insertion altitude
New Glenn exploded during a test, creating delays for Amazon Leo's satellite rollout (exact date not disclosed in source)

The fifth Atlas V 551 launch for the program was delayed by predicted inclement weather; the broader capacity shortfall is separately attributed to launch-vehicle availability across ULA/Blue Origin/ArianeGroup and prototype 'reengineering' work (exact resolution date not disclosed in source)

evm_rollup.notes: BAC/AC/EV summed from mart_cashflow_breakdown's 22 subcategories -- same period, same cost scope. AC already exceeds BAC in this scenario, which makes tcpi_to_bac mathematically negative/degenerate: recovering the original budget is not just unlikely, it is undefined. tcpi_to_eac (using eac_cpi, the primary book number) is the metric that is actually interpretable here.
